## 3. DESCRIPTION (Final Public Copy — Plain Text)
The night slowly releases its grip as the first light of morning appears.
The room stays quiet.
A CRT monitor glows softly, terminal text scrolling as the sky begins to warm.
This 3-hour LoFi + Synthwave mix is designed for early-morning focus — calm coding sessions, gentle studying, writing, or starting the day with clarity. Soft rhythms and analog textures gradually lift the energy without breaking concentration.
All music is royalty-free and safe for content creators.
Best for:

Aesthetic:
